method: Whole3files manually read; pinned Git byte comparison. No Windows compatibility execution.
findings: VTRACE formats source-location/debug message and calls OutputDebugString only under compile-time IsDebugBuild. As function call, argument expressions may still evaluate in Release despite empty function body; no macro-style lazy-evaluation guarantee.
UiFramework header adds app-exit and toolbar/status routing; toggles existing bar visibility and layout. Full custom window/message implementation remains elsewhere, no MFC parity claim.

Legacy CreateFile2 shim prefers native lookup, validates extended parameter size/flag subset then translates to CreateFileW. Runtime lookup preserves GetLastError. No unsupported flag/old-OS execution performed.

Precise time shim falls back GetSystemTimeAsFileTime; fallback does not preserve precise-clock resolution. WaitOnAddress validates pointer/size then memcmp polling, sleeps up to10ms finite waits or1ms infinite waits.
WakeByAddress fallbacks do nothing because polling handles eventual changed-value observation. Latency/memory-order semantics and Windows synchronization parity untested.
Import aliases emitted for x86/x64; project excludes file on ARM64. Presence of compatibility shims and WINVER macros does not qualify full application old-Windows support.
limits: No legacy Windows, scheduler, memory-order, loader/import or timing runtime qualification.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
